Name: Cottontail Rabbits
Author: dragonsir
Description:
[size=6] [size=6]COMPATIBLE WITH 1.6 UPDATE[/size][/size]

Made a slight change to the baby rabbit sprite to make the nose more noticable

[line]

Ever wondered why your rabbits don't look like the ones that run around in the wild? That's because you don't have this mod! Now your rabbits will look like adorable cottontails, complete with a fluffy cotton tail.

This is a simple content patcher mod that replaces the vanilla rabbit textures. I included example pics from in-game as well as some sprites. 

[size=5]Installation[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip this file into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
I may consider adding other colors/textures for rabbits if there is any interest.
Thank you!
